# Dispatchlet

> A research agent for Buffer. Describe what you post about once; on a schedule it finds new stories, skips what it has covered, writes a post per channel and puts them in Buffer as drafts or in the queue. Built for Buffer Commit 2026 by Barry Michael Doyle. Not a Buffer product.

## Docs

- [How it works](https://dispatchlet.com/docs): playbooks, runs, posting modes, limits, the text format
- [The API](https://dispatchlet.com/docs/api): personal tokens, every route, errors, rate limits
- [Webhooks](https://dispatchlet.com/docs/webhooks): signed events (Standard Webhooks) when runs finish and posts go out
- [Inbound hooks](https://dispatchlet.com/docs/hooks): start a run from a cron, a Zap or a GitHub release
- [MCP server](https://dispatchlet.com/docs/mcp): tools for Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Cursor
- [What a run costs](https://dispatchlet.com/blog/cost-per-run): cost per run, and the benchmark behind the choice of models

## Machine endpoints

- OpenAPI 3.1: https://dispatchlet.com/api/v1/openapi.json
- REST base URL: https://dispatchlet.com/api/v1 (Authorization: Bearer dl_…)
- MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://dispatchlet.com/mcp (Authorization: Bearer dl_…, or OAuth 2.1 via /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp)
